findings.text: follow-on: the manifest follow_ons line still says "jtmm-op1-shot-fetch should cache the 22 listed shots", the pre-repair count, while commit 8d089ab2 reduced the delivered list from 22 entries to 16; the next node's brief would be sized against a list that no longer exists, and the corrected count belongs in the reviewed run's manifest.

item_verdicts.diff: The repair commit 8d089ab2 regenerates the machine-readable list from the same three ranking tables the fragment shows (22 entries -> 16; E101153 and E101031 restored, E101030 dropped), restricts the peak-beta ranking to a flat-top window >= 1.0 s with the five excluded shots listed beside both medians, and gives the fragment root class="evidence-fragment" data-reckon="evidence". Commit 0bfaffd5 gives the beta-exclusion note a unique element id. All four commits carry conventional subjects with mechanism bodies and no AI attribution.
item_verdicts.done_when: The node's own measure is the read-only EDDB re-read reproducing the source table's 228 plasma shots. I verified it independently: logs/calip2.txt holds exactly 228 C records, all ipmax >= 50000 A, first E100599, against 1167 shots in logs/sweep.txt (positive control), and imas-efit docs/jt60sa-shot-candidates.html states 228. The three ranking metrics re-derive from logs/calip2.txt and logs/beta2.txt and match the fragment's tables value for value, including the 113-eligible count and the five-shot exclusion table. The measure is met.
item_verdicts.goal: The clause asks the node to start from imas-efit's 228-shot table without re-characterising it, read only what the table lacks (peak beta from the EDDB FAME category, and the catalogue tools beside eddbreadCatTable), rank the OP1 plasma shots by peak sustained plasma current, peak beta and plasma volume while marking PSRC presence, identify the first JT-60SA plasma, and deliver an identified OP1 shot list with a date, peak values, PSRC presence and a reason per entry. At head 0bfaffd5 the fragment carries the tool inventory with the command that read each (jtmm-op1-shot-survey.html lines 5-12), the first plasma E100599 (2023-10-20, 76.1 kA), and the three rankings with date, peaks, units and PSRC/FAME columns; the JSON is now exactly the union of the three top-five rankings plus the first plasma (16 entries), so the machine-readable half is no longer a subset. The clause is met; the residual is that peak beta is ranked by the flat-top median rather than the literal per-slice maximum, a documented substitution for a corrupted statistic.
item_verdicts.manifest: Records head 0bfaffd5 with commits 74c11b08, 5550a072, 8d089ab2, 0bfaffd5, the read-only survey command with its 228-reproduced result and four log paths, the catalogue-tool inventory with units, the flat-top-median beta rule with its five excluded shots, and an honest raw-vs-flat-top beta distinction; the checkpoint, landing and artifacts lines all now read 16 entries and the corrected beta head E101163, resolving the two contradictions the first review found. Blemish: the follow_ons line still names "the 22 listed shots", the pre-repair count, while the delivered list holds 16.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The full range bb99ef9f..0bfaffd5 touches only docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-op1-shot-survey.html and .json — commit 8d089ab2 both, commit 0bfaffd5 the HTML only — exactly the manifest's changed_paths and within the figure/fragment fence; the declared figures path docs/figures/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-op1-shot-survey is unused, and no plan, sprint, index or other node's file is modified.

justifications.durability: The repair realigned the two halves by hand rather than adding a regenerating script, so the fragment's ranking tables and the JSON remain independent hand-maintained copies that can drift again — exactly the drift that produced the first review's defect when 5550a072 regenerated the HTML but not the JSON; the values are all recorded and reproducible from the logs, but the list is not rebuildable in one command.
justifications.evidence: Every value reproduces from the run's own artifacts — 228 plasma shots from logs/calip2.txt against 1167 in logs/sweep.txt, the peak-sustained-current top five and the whole beta ranking from logs/calip2.txt and logs/beta2.txt, and the five-shot beta-exclusion table with both medians; the volume head E101017 177.25 m3 and the whole volume ranking corroborate against imas-efit docs/jt60sa-shot-candidates.html. Held below full only because the volume column has no gate log of its own in the run directory, so it is corroborated against the source table rather than reproduced from the run's logs.
justifications.fit: The fragment now follows the substantive evidence conventions: the root section carries class="evidence-fragment" data-reckon="evidence" like its siblings, the JSON is linked with a project-absolute href, and the tables carry dates, units, source-per-column and a caveat beside the affected ranking; it is held at 18 because no figure was produced although a figures write path was granted and three numeric rankings over a shot space would read better with one.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The node does its clause comprehensively: the tool list names eddbreadCatTable plus four companions with the command that read each, the first plasma E100599 76.1 kA is evidential and confirmed to be the earliest shot above 50 kA from logs/calip2.txt, and the 16-entry JSON is exactly the union of the three ranking tables plus the first plasma so every ranked shot is carried; it is held one point below full because the beta ranking substitutes the flat-top median for the clause's literal peak beta, a justified but still documented departure.
justifications.reuse: Read-only and additive: the node reuses the existing fragment-plus-JSON convention and adds no module, reader or abstraction; it duplicates no mechanism and retires nothing, so the reuse budget is clean.
justifications.scope_discipline: Both repair commits touch only the two declared fragment paths; the range diff bb99ef9f..0bfaffd5 is exactly those two files, equal to the manifest's changed_paths, and no plan, sprint, index or other node's file is modified.
